    [mild] Lemma 2.1, Case I #

    With τ' ≫ α = α ≫ ρ (Case I), neither ρ factoring through α or β nor the alternative (2) through γ or δ, a cleaving diagram exists in P/τ: the crowns of MildContour.caseIa, MildContour.caseIb, the Ẽ₇ and Ẽ₈ trees of [mild] figure 2.2, and the D̃₄ of [mild] figure 2.1 (third diagram).
